name: City of Austin - Digital and Website Accessibility statement
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (stated as a goal: 'strives to meet')

policy_docs.title: Austin City Manager's Office - Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Digital and Website Accessibility

applies_to: City of Austin websites and digital services.
requires: Target WCAG 2.1 AA; auxiliary aids and services on request; complaints to the ADA Program Office
mobile: not addressed in the statement - Title II mobile app rule applies.
enforcement: City ADA Program Office complaints; federal Title II.
notes: No formal adopted digital accessibility policy document was found. The edims document id=457803 is a 2025-08-27 presentation to the Joint Inclusion Committee by CTM Digital Strategies ('Access and Use of City of Austin's Digital Products'), not a policy. Texas state agencies are separately governed by Texas Gov't Code ch. 2054 subch. M and 1 TAC 206/213 (not verified here; does not bind cities).
